duration: Team practice Mondays and Thursdays 6 to 9 pm, plus Saturdays as needed
pay_detail: Team registration fee (amount not stated). Donations also help fund teams.
name: Biome Robotics (FIRST Tech Challenge teams)
org: The Science House, NC State University
what_you_do: Join a FIRST Tech Challenge robotics team that designs, builds and programs robots. Teams meet twice a week and go to scrimmages and tournaments.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page. Contact Kent Lupino for current team openings.
how_to_apply: Contact the program (Kent Lupino, named on the page) to ask about joining a team.
notes: The page does not give a season or the fee. Tournaments can go to the state, regional and national level if a team qualifies.
